title: Creators in numbers
heading: How far off is your gut?
intro: Eight real numbers about online creators, the brands they build, and the hills many of them film in.
Every figure is real and sourced. Bet on how sure you are, not just on what you think.

outro.heading: Attention is the new currency.
paras: Creators can reach more people than many TV channels, and some have turned that reach into businesses worth billions. Most never get close.
Today, think about what a creator really brings to a product, and what they risk.

questions.q: In 2025 MrBeast became the first YouTuber to pass a new subscriber milestone. Which one?
questions.explain: 400 million, at the start of June 2025, the first individual creator to get there. A year later, in June 2026, the channel passed 500 million.
questions.source: YouTube Official Blog, June 2026; press reports, June 2025

questions.q: The YouTubers KSI and Logan Paul launched the drink Prime in 2022. Roughly what were its sales in 2023 expected to reach, according to Bloomberg?
questions.sub: a reported projection, not audited accounts
questions.explain: More than $1.2 billion, Bloomberg reported in November 2023, less than two years after launch. In the UK, some supermarkets limited how many bottles each customer could buy.

questions.q: Scotland's Munros are its mountains over 3,000 feet (914 metres). How many are there?
questions.explain: 282. They are named after Sir Hugh Munro, who listed them in 1891. Climbing all of them, 'compleating', is a goal for thousands of walkers.

questions.q: In November 2020 Charli D'Amelio became the first person to reach 100 million followers on which platform?
questions.explain: TikTok, about 18 months after she started posting dance videos there in May 2019. Brands such as Dunkin', Hollister and Morphe worked with her as her following grew.

questions.q: In March 2020, after UK schools closed, Joe Wicks streamed a live PE lesson on YouTube every weekday morning. On day two, how many households watched live?
questions.explain: About 955,000 (955,185), a Guinness World Record for a live-streamed workout on YouTube. He said he would give the YouTube income from the lessons to NHS charities.

questions.q: Hailey Bieber launched the skincare brand Rhode in 2022. In 2025 the beauty company e.l.f. agreed to buy it. For up to how much?
questions.explain: Up to $1 billion: $800 million on completion plus up to $200 million more if the brand kept growing over the next three years. Rhode had launched in 2022, helped by Bieber's huge social media following.
questions.source: e.l.f. Beauty, press release (SEC filing), May 2025

questions.q: Gymshark began in 2012 in a garage near Birmingham and grew through fitness creators on social media. In 2020 an investor valued it at what?
questions.explain: More than £1 billion (about £1.25bn), when General Atlantic bought a 21% stake. Ben Francis had started it at 19, in his parents' garage, while delivering pizzas.

questions.q: Huda Kattan's Huda Beauty is one of the best-known creator-led make-up brands. How did it begin, in 2010?
questions.explain: As a beauty blog. Her first product, false eyelashes, followed in 2013, and the brand grew through her huge online following.
